text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Though she narrowly missed victory, the experience gained in a race packed with fierce rivals will surely become an invaluable asset."

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
That was a fantastic race!
You shone even brighter than before!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Someday you might shine as bright as the midday sun—
Ha-ha, I hope I get to see that up close.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Good work today. Your footsteps were splendid—resonating like the rumbling of the earth itself.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: I want to see that magnificent figure once more.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Darley Arabian and Byerley Turk
both look even happier than usual, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...However, we must not be satisfied with this.
And of course, neither of us are.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
The great success and fulfillment of the Umamusume is the wish of the Three Goddesses.
And because we wish for it, we want to test them.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: The stage where you learn whether the Umamusume you raised through thick and thin has reached the pinnacle of running—

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
From her past runs and how she runs now,
I shall judge whether <chrname> is fit
to stand upon that grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
If you should cross paths with each other,
you must face her as an opponent you need to defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, feeling <chrname>'s growth firsthand,
the SWBC came to a close.
